subject: MSA & Order Form — DPA / SCCs: hosting, KMS, and transfer addendum negotiation
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medatlas.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medatlas.com>, procurement@medatlas.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: MSA + Order Form redlines: DPA & SCCs (MedAtlas)

Hi Michael,

Please find attached our redlines to the MSA and the Data Processing Addendum. Two items we need clarity on before procurement can move forward:

1) Hosting / residency: We need confirmation that EU customer data can be pinned to an EU region and that you will not egress to non-EU for processing without prior notice.

2) KMS & key control: Our security team insists on either customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) for EU-hosted instances or a contractual commitment from Redwood on key custody and auditability.

3) Transfer impact / surcharge: If Redwood cannot provide the above without extra engineering, our procurement lead has requested a one-time transfer-surcharge line on the Order Form to cover the third-party compliance review and additional logging we will ask for. Can you confirm whether this is acceptable or whether Redwood will absorb?

We are on a tight timeline — we’d like to sign in the next 10 business days. Attaching our redlines (MSA and DPA).

Attachments: MedAtlas_redline_MSA.docx (redline), MedAtlas_DPA_redline.docx (redline)

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Sr. Counsel, MedAtlas
sofia.ramos@medatlas.com

- Internal infra team will confirm EU region pinning feasibility and KMS options by EOD Monday.
- We will propose a tidy compromise that avoids a recurring surcharge if possible — but will surface a one-time engineering pass charge only if we truly need custom infra work.

Can you share the procurement contact’s expected PO terms (payment window) and whether a DocuSign envelope is being prepared? If you can push the DocuSign link we’ll prioritize the legal review to meet your 10-business-day target.

I’ve attached an initial response doc (redline_response_v1.docx) — Ben and Laura, please review and iterate.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form redlines: DPA & SCCs (MedAtlas)

Sofia / team — thanks for the redlines. I reviewed the MSA and DPA and here are concrete options (trying to keep procurement moving while protecting product/ops):

Option A (preferred for speed):
- Redwood accepts EU region pinning and will provide KMS audit logs and a documented key custody process.
- Insert a Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) as an exhibit to the DPA: short, time-bound (90 days) requirement to produce an evidence package (hosting topology, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS audit artifacts).
- No surcharge on the Order Form; instead, include an explicit "advance remediation credit" clause: if work beyond standard config is requested (custom HSM integration), the parties will agree on a one-time professional services fee, to be estimated in the Order Form.

Suggested redline snippet (for the DPA exhibit):
"Transfer Impact Addendum (Exhibit X): Redwood will (i) deploy Customer EU data to an EU region as specified in the Order Form, (ii) provide KMS audit logs and a KMS custody statement within ten (10) business days of execution, and (iii) where Customer requests non-standard key custody (customer-managed HSM integration), parties will agree a one-time engineering fee in the Order Form prior to implementation."

Option B (if MedAtlas requires an upfront surcharge):
- Redwood will accept a one-time transfer compliance fee as a line item on the Order Form, capped and non-recurring. In exchange, Redwood will commit to a 15-business-day evidence delivery SLA and an escalation path.

Practical asks for your legal/procurement team:
- Confirm whether your security team will accept the evidence package (template attached).
- If you need HSM integration, please provide the HSM spec and expected timelines so we can estimate the fee.

Attachment: proposed_dpa_clause_snippet.txt (contains the exact redline text above for cut/paste).

If this works, I’ll fold our redlines into Michael’s response doc and aim to return a consolidated redline by Monday EOD.

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:46:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form redlines: DPA & SCCs (MedAtlas)

Michael / Ben / Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround and the two options. Procurement is inclined to avoid an open-ended engineering ask. Our preference is Option A with two clarifications: 

1) Evidence SLA: 10 business days for initial KMS audit logs is acceptable, but we need the TIA to specify a template and minimum fields (key IDs, rotation policy, geo of key store).
2) Fee visibility: if HSM integration is required, procurement needs a capped estimate or a not-to-exceed line on the Order Form (we can approve subject to that cap).

We will get the HSM spec (if required) and procurement PO terms over by EOD Wednesday. We will prepare a DocuSign envelope once we have the consolidated redline. Please include the TIA exhibit and the not-to-exceed language in your next redline so we can push this to signature.

DocuSign / Procurement note: our procurement lead asks that the DocuSign envelope include an Order Form with the following fields filled if possible: billing contact, PO number field, and the capped transfer-compliance fee (if applicable).

Thanks — let’s aim to close next week.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Sr. Counsel, MedAtlas
